summary: Finished slice 3 of the revision-2 tidy-up on top of the already-built AppShell, footer toggle, cmdk palette, ConsoleNav Hide control and controlled GitBar. Added the revision-2 plan content to docs/ui-tidy-up-plan.md (sections 11-16: footer toggle, full palette command list with real shortcuts or No shortcut, hide/reopen table, the single remembered td.sidebarCollapsed field, package decisions with the in-house reasons, and a revision-2 state check kept outside the S/P/D/B inventory rows so the R1 plan tests still pass). package.json/package-lock.json already pin cmdk 1.1.1 (MIT, React ^18||^19); src/test/setup.ts was left unchanged because the existing observer/scroll shims already satisfy cmdk. Added an R10 test proving the palette is cmdk (a [cmdk-root] element), cmdk is pinned in the manifest, and the palette module is not evaluated while App is imported. Stabilised one App.shortcuts focus assertion with waitFor after a full-run timing flake. npm run lint, npm run build and the full suite (43 files, 422 tests) pass; cmdk is emitted only in dist/assets/CommandPalette-*.js, not the entry chunk.
